title: Quant profile provenance index and time-windowed regression adjudicator
creator: Aisha Khatri
description:
Problem: We onboard INT8/GPTQ/AWQ/FP8 quant profiles daily from external toolkits and internal conversion pipelines. Today we lack a canonical provenance index that ties a quant profile artifact to: source model commit, quant tool and version, hyperparameters used (per-layer), calibration seed, and the validation snapshot used to certify perf. Without this mapping we cannot reliably roll back to the exact artifact that caused a regression and our canary adjudication rules have high false-positive rates when models change rapidly.

Goal: Build a lightweight, queryable provenance index and a time-windowed regression adjudicator that reduces noisy alerts and enables deterministic rollback/pinning. Deliverables: (1) a normalized metadata schema for quant profiles, (2) a provenance index service (read-heavy, append-only writes) that links artifacts to upstream commits/containers, (3) an adjudicator that compares rolling-window metrics (latency/throughput/quality) against a pinned baseline and only surfaces sustained regression signals, and (4) a small UI patch in Console to inspect profile lineage and rollback suggestions.

Scope decisions and constraints: Keep runtime impact minimal: index writes occur at profile publish time (not on inference path). Adjudicator runs asynchronously and emits findings as structured events to telemetry pipeline (no blocking). We will reuse existing artifact signing and S3 storage; new component is a Postgres-backed index with a simple JSONB column for flexible per-layer params. We intentionally avoid a heavy graph DB for now to reduce ops surface.

Success metrics: reduction in regression noise (alerts/false-positive rate) by >60% during staged rollout, mean time to rollback reduced from ~4h to <30m for quant-induced regressions, and >90% of published profiles include complete provenance metadata.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement automated rollback; it produces validated rollback recommendations and the playbook to execute them. It also does not create new model evaluation suites — it uses existing eval snapshot harnesses (see dependencies).
comments: 2025-02-12 by Aisha Khatri: Kickoff — aligned with Research and Infra. Drafted metadata schema and proposed minimal index model. Raised concern about schema drift; decided on extensible JSONB for per-layer params.

2025-02-18 by Miguel Torres: POC done — metadata schema stored as metadata.json with fields: source_commit, quant_tool, quant_version, per_layer_params, calibration_seed, validation_snapshot_id, artifact_uri, signed_by. Pushed initial schema PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-profiles/pull/187

2025-02-22 by Sanjay Patel (Research): Validation snapshot binding added — each profile must reference an immutable eval snapshot id (S3 prefix). We will fail publish if snapshot not present. Follow-up: add tooling to copy snapshots to cold storage for reproducibility.

2025-02-25 by Miguel Torres: Integrated index write into publish pipeline. Publish flow now POSTs to /profiles/index with signature verification. Reworked CI to include a lightweight smoke eval that computes baseline latency, p95, token/sec and a small accuracy score. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/publish-pipeline/pull/46

2025-02-27 by Ops (Riley Chen): Deployed Postgres instance with 3x read replicas for index service; added DB migration script. Noted that retention policy is 365d for quick lookups, deeper archives move to Glacier-equivalent storage.

2025-03-01 by Miguel Torres: Adjudicator prototype running in staging — it computes rolling 1h and 24h windows and compares to baseline pinned profile. Uses hysteresis rules (requires >5% regression sustained over 3 consecutive windows) before emitting an alert. Reduces single-window flakiness. Test run across 50 profiles shows 72% drop in noisy alerts.

2025-03-02 by QA (Lena Moretti): Found edge-case where quant tool version string uses non-semver tag (e.g., 'main-20250301') and index query by semver fails. Action: accept free-form version strings for storage and add normalized_tag field when semver parse succeeds. Miguel to patch publish flow.

2025-03-03 by Product (Noah Blake): Prioritization review — approved shipping index + adjudicator as beta in next runtime release; Console surface to be minimal (lineage table + rollback suggestion link). Roadmap: full lineage graph and automated rollback in a follow-up cycle.
